crossRefs.note: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

translations.web: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;
translations.bsb: And on the lampstand there shall be four cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals.
translations.kjv: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.
translations.asv: and in the candlestick four cups made like almond-blossoms, the knops thereof, and the flowers thereof;
